usedFor: Content Workflow Bynder holds items, comments and statuses, and Hastewire runs “Detect Text” to check whether text is AI-generated.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Created” in Content Workflow Bynder, then “Detect Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: Every new item gets checked as it enters the workflow, so the AI-generated text question is asked up front.

watchOut: “Detect Text” only checks for AI-generated text, so pair it with a trigger that carries text, like “Comment Was Added”.
